title: document.discovered
description: The crawler fetched a document it had not seen at this source and stored the raw file. Producer: pipeline (source crawler). Consumers: pipeline (change detector).

source_id.description: The source the document was listed at.

regulator.description: Regulator the source belongs to, such as cbic or fssai.

url.description: Where the document was fetched from.

external_ref.description: The source's own reference, such as a notification number; empty when the listing had none.

title.description: Title as listed at the source; empty when unknown.

published_at.description: Publication date as listed at the source; null when unknown.

media_type.description: Media type of the raw file.

raw_uri.description: Where the raw file is stored (object store URI).
